designs: A 17 year old boy from Peckham, South London, with a very thick roadman Multicultural London English accent, like a UK drill rapper talking casually on Snapchat. Fast, loud, hyped, slurred casual street speech, heavy glottal stops, 'th' becomes 'f', flat vowels, Jamaican-influenced rhythm. Messy and natural, slightly raspy, definitely not a narrator.
